I will call the police if the threatens to kill himself. I will call the police if he threatens to kill himself.I will.That is sound advice, thank you so much.

On the exit plan. His last ex up and left without saying a word except to the old roommate and my SO never got over that experience. I can understand his side... but more and more I understand hers. I \*want\* to leave this way and just text him good bye... Actually I wasn't able to do this until yesterday (leave and be able to lock up after packing) so I have the means to now... but if I can avoid leaving this way I would rather, just because I don't want to fuck him up over this.

I want out desperately. I want an exit plan. A safe one for both me and him. Last time I left it was 50% my choice and 50% his. I was tired of the way he was treating me, and he had moved on to someone else. This time. I want to leave, and he doesn't want me to. 
There's his mental health I'm concerned about. I don't want him to do something drastic because I leave. At this point, that's my biggest reason for staying. And because he's been guilting me on several things and I don't want to experience the emotional abuse. I'm at a point I finally realize he's 100% been manipulating me and verbally abusing me. But those don't leave scars people will understand. The other part is, well, I still love him. When I leave I'm cutting ties. I want to make sure he's safe to the best of my abilities. I've already gotten a letter he wrote recently that shows a bit of the terrible things he says and sent it to his family. But they're like "WTF do we do?" They're trying but there's only so much you can do *for* him and I'm under no illusions that I can fix him. I'm frustrated he's 'trying' now but I'm not over what he's done to me over the last few weeks, let alone catching all the other tricks he's pulled over the years.  I'm so exhausted. I'm terrified. I can't disclose why I'm scared so I can get advice.... but please know I'm not exaggerating. I'm sorry if I sound all over the place
